About me

Director of Photography and camera operator based in Edinburgh, working primarily across Scotland and the UK on commercials, short films, and branded content.

Alongside freelance projects, I work closely with the team at MBP in Edinburgh, with direct access to the equipment, studio, and post facilities when a project needs it.
